forbidden: Only a paired device with full access can load pictures from replies.
bad_url: That picture's address can't be loaded: only http and https addresses work.
address_not_allowed: That picture's address isn't on the open internet, so the hub won't fetch it.
too_large: That picture is too large to load.
unsupported_type: That address isn't a JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, HEIC or AVIF picture.
fetch_failed: Couldn't fetch that picture. Try again later.
timeout: Fetching that picture took too long. Try again later.
rate_limited: Too many pictures were fetched just now. Try again in a moment.
